about_the_game:
Welcome to Project D.O.O.O.O.O.R.S.

Welcome to the Department Of Obviously Overcomplicated Opening Operation Research Service — or simply, D.O.O.O.O.O.R.S.

As a newly recruited trainee, you will operate an old CRT surveillance terminal, remotely directing test subjects through a series of absurd yet rigorously scientific “door-control experiments.”

About the Game

Project D.O.O.O.O.O.R.S. is a pure logic puzzle game.

Every move is governed by strict rules and discrete turn-based updates.
There are no action elements, no random factors—only the pure satisfaction of reasoning, experimentation, and sudden insight.

The game’s core revolves around a single principle:

Trigger the mechanism — open the door.

From this simple rule, countless puzzle variations emerge. The design emphasizes the “chemical reactions” between elements, rather than piling on distracting mechanics—allowing players to fully enjoy the interplay of state switching, spatial manipulation, and temporal sequencing.

Key Features

  • Unique Atmosphere
    DOS-like interface, CCTV-style camera feeds, and cold bureaucratic documents combine to create an absurd yet immersive laboratory setting.

  • Minimalist Core Mechanic
    Everything stems from “trigger → door opens.”
    Through interacting rules and strict turn-based simulation, this simple premise blossoms into dynamic spatial puzzles.

  • Deadpan Humor
    Official documents and system prompts are delivered in a dry, bureaucratic tone—masking satire and absurdity that reveal themselves between the lines.

  • Box Carrying, Not Pushing
    Instead of traditional Sokoban-style pushing, boxes are carried, shifting focus from step-counting to spatial strategy. Carrying itself becomes one of the game’s central mechanics.

For Players Who…

  • Love pure logical deduction and the thrill of discovering emergent solutions.

  • Appreciate clinical, experimental atmospheres laced with satire and absurd humor.

  • Enjoy puzzle classics like I Wanna Lockpick, A Monster's Expedition, or Stephen’s Sausage Roll.

Then, Project D.O.O.O.O.O.R.S. is a puzzle experience you should not miss.

short_description: A pure logic puzzle game. Through an old CRT monitor and a DOS-style interface, remotely control test subjects to solve mechanical puzzles and reach the exit within the absurdly overcomplicated experiments on doors. No reflexes. No randomness. Only strict logic and cold regulations.
